title: IAEA Live Chart: 239Pu half-life 24110 Y (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 239Pu lists half-life 24110 with unit Y. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 30 years.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 239Pu (Z=94, N=145), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 24110, unit_hl Y, unc_hl 30, half_life_sec 760837485247.4131, and unc_hls 946707779.23776. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 31556926 seconds per unit, so unit code Y is years in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 30 years. The unc_hl value 30 is that same absolute uncertainty of 30 years. The leading decay field is A at 100 percent. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 30-Jun-2013. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 239Pu
sources.author: International Atomic Energy Agency, Live Chart of Nuclides

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.
Removed a clause that said the uncertainty was not the absolute number of years. For this row unc_hl matches the seconds column as that many years.

Linked the October 2023 NNDC wallet-card half-life world.physics.nndc-pu-239-half-life. The IAEA numerals in this card were not rewritten. iaea.org remains class other, so this card's evidence stays weak.
